verdict.rationale: Otter's pricing page lists a Zapier integration. Its integrations pages show notes and action items flowing into Airtable, ClickUp, Jira, Asana, S3, and custom systems via the API and webhooks, so the core idea of pushing notes into work tools is supported. However, nothing in the evidence names Slack or Notion; the one sync item (otter-docs-32) does not name a target tool. Missing for 10: evidence of a Slack channel integration, evidence of a Notion page integration, any detail on Zapier triggers or actions beyond a pricing-page bullet, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
